WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM account
    GROUP BY district_id
),
shares AS (
    SELECT district_id,
           account_count,
           1.0 * account_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS share
    FROM district_counts
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT s.district_id,
       s.account_count,
       s.share,
       s.share - a.avg_share AS share_above_average
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
ORDER BY share_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
